status: Implemented and independently reviewed; full tests, release, graphics and native input checks passed.

budgets.qualification: Subsystem timings; no whole-game FPS claim. Same inherited ceilings set before graphics acceptance.

core.scenario: Authored starts, initially alerted live AI, scripted movement/jumps, real alarm response and optional ordinary frag throws. Death restarts are measured. Population bounds, water contacts and optical events expose differing environment workloads; this is CPU simulation cost, not GPU frame time.

validation.routes: All three classes complete physical movement/interactions to both exits with combat isolated. All 12 openings walked; ordinary AI crosses a broken panel; single radio retreat breach is >2m and >0.3s shorter.
validation.independentReview: Core, Mac and actual images reviewed. Terrain wall outside east panes fixed by moving raised house foundations east. Radio moved to central greenhouse; briefing matches.
validation.nativeUI: Sirocco selected, field operation started, frag count 4 to 3, pause/resume verified. Not a full manual combat mission.
validation.release: ARM64 optimized build and signature passed. Final grenade diagnostic fixture is included in the #31 release and its actual three-explosion aftermath image passed visual review.
validation.limitations: Ruins benchmark explicitly starts with destroyed panes. Final aftermath fixture uses three ordinary throws from a safe valid starting distance; original too-close fixture bounced back and killed the player, so its failed image is not acceptance evidence.
